---
title: "RVA Sourcebook"
---

A basic reference for Richmond-region housing data — inventory, demographics, and market conditions — pulled from public sources (Census/ACS, BLS) and kept current as new data releases.

- [Inventory](inventory.qmd) — housing stock, occupancy, structure type, permits
- [Demographics](demographics.qmd) — population, households, income
- [Market](market.qmd) — tenure, home values, rents, cost burden

See [Data Notes](data-notes.qmd) for sources and methodology, and [About](about.qmd) for what this project is.
